messages:
samira (AM): Quick heads-up: Marigold Bio wants a 2-week POC to validate model fit for clinical note normalization. Theywant a 13B-int8 cheap path + a 70B-fp16 high-accuracy variant. Procurement asks about EU residency, weights isolation, and whether we can offer a short fixed-rate POC. Estimated volume ~80M tokens/month.

harper (sales-eng): Recommended POC pricing: hosted tokens at 28% off for the trial + waived infra for first 48h. If they insist on flat fee, legal needs to review.

marta (infra): 28% ok for hosted. Dedicated 13B-int8 is fine in eu-west-1. 70B requires A100 slices; capacity limited. Option: primary dedicated 13B-int8 + hosted 70B fallback. For weights isolation: we store artifacts on encrypted isolated volumes; customer KMS keys supported. Full single-tenant hardware only on Private.

ezra (ml eng): Drop the HF id and their typical seq lengths and Ill run a quick compat pass. Int8 path often has fused ops requiring fallback kernels in older checkpoints.

samira (AM): HF id: hf.co/marigold/clin-normalizer-v1. Avg 480 tokens, peak 2048. Theyalso want a simple eval harness and latency SLOs.

ezra (ml eng): Ran compat check: `./compat-check --model hf://marigold/clin-normalizer-v1 --quant int8,fp16 --runtime rwd-v2`. Findings: tokenizer OK. INT8 checkpoint uses three fused ops not covered by our int8 optimized kernels -> runtime will use generic kernels for those ops (GPU unaffected, CPU inference fallback may see +8-15% overhead). FP16 path clean.

leo (solutions): Can we get 512/2048 latency numbers for both variants by EOD? Also drafting security Q answers and a short SOW blurb for region pinning and fallback routing.

ezra (ml eng): Quick single-rep numbers (batch=1):
13B-INT8 (dedicated): 480 -> 110ms avg, 2048 -> 410ms avg
70B-FP16 (hosted): 480 -> 340ms avg, 2048 -> 1050ms avg
I'll run a 12h perf run overnight and upload CSV to artifacts.

marta (infra): Routing sketch for SOW: `primary: marigold/13b-int8@dedicated-eu; fallback: marigold/70b-fp16@hosted-eu; timeout_ms: 1500; region_pin: eu-west-1`. This keeps P99 low and meets residency.

harper (sales-eng): Procurement wants a one-liner on data residency: "POC traffic and logs are pinned to eu-west-1 and artifacts stored in-region encrypted with customer KMS keys." Good to send?

marta (infra): Yes. Add audit log retention per enterprise SLA.

samira (AM): Action items: (1) ezra: 12h perf + CSV + short eval (2) leo: security Q + SOW routing snippet (3) harper: finalize POC pricing blurb and flat-fee fallback wording (4) marta: reserve dedicated 13B pool and confirm capacity. Need to share with procurement by EOD to start Monday.

ezra (ml eng): Starting 12h run now. Note: int8 fused-op fallback should not change GPU throughput but may slightly affect tail latency on CPU-side tooling. Will include cost-per-1k-token comparisons with fallback enabled.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: reserve-dedicated-marigold (job id: dp-2026-03-21-128).

marta (infra): Reserving 3x g5g.12x for 13B pool in eu-west-1. Estimated sustained throughput ~5.8k tokens/s. Will confirm replica sizing in an hour.

samira (AM): Great. If the perf + security Q look good we can lock pricing and get the SOW signed. Ping me for any urgent blockers. :thumbsup:
